::: {#exm-hers-risk-ratio}
#### Risk ratio of regular exercise in HERS

Take group 1 to be hormone therapy and group 2, the [reference group](#def-reference-group), to be placebo.
The estimated [risk ratio](#def-risk-ratio)
for the estimated [risks](#def-outcome-risk) of @exm-hers-outcome-risk is:

```{r}
#| label: hers-risk-ratio
#| code-fold: false
rr_hat <- risk_hat[["hormone therapy"]] / risk_hat[["placebo"]]
rr_hat
```

The estimated [risk](#def-outcome-risk) of regular exercise in the hormone therapy group
is `r round(rr_hat, 3)` times the estimated risk in the placebo group.
This [estimate](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) is close to 1,
which agrees with the large [p-value](inference.qmd#def-p-value) of @exm-hers-chisq:
the two groups have about the same estimated risk.
The estimate alone does not show how precise it is.
:::
